rule: Belt only on primary spine-loaded strength/test sets at <= 8 reps and <= 2 RIR
summary: Lab studies show a belt raises intra-abdominal pressure and trunk stiffness in heavy lifts, with mixed effect on spine load; no trial ties belt use to injury. Restricting it to heavy primary sets is a sensible habit, not a tested rule.

sources.note: Lander 1992: belt raised intra-abdominal pressure across multi-rep squats
1990 lab study: belts change trunk muscle activity/IAP little in short lifts; hard to justify for workers
